caption: The drawing depicts a chest of drawers with a rectangular shape, rendered in a black or very dark shade. The chest consists of four horizontal drawers, each decorated with symmetrical floral and foliate patterns. The floral designs feature a combination of red, orange, and yellow flower motifs, with green and gold leaves and stems intricately arranged in repeating patterns across the width of each drawer. The border of the chest is outlined in black, with a slightly protruding top and base. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color. The name “ISABELLA RUTH DOERFLER” is inscribed in small, neat print at the lower right corner of the page.
title: Painted Chest of Drawers
